title: スプリンターズSの後に・次の満腹！

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: In first, it's Hishi Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's huge! And the force and speed she ran with was terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You can say that again! I got some awesome shots! Now I feel bad for joking about wanting to get funny pics of her…

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text: Bono is usually so easygoing, but that intensity and focus she has on the racetrack is so cool!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan B
text_block_list.text: For sure. I think I'll go see her next race too! I might be hooked!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Yay, yay! I won, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Everyone was giving their best, and it was so much fun! I'm so glad the fans had fun too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It was like a dream! I feel so happy and full!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to run my next race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I hope it'll make me feel just as—no, I hope my next one will make me feel even fuller than today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono's full-body conditioning has paid off, and she's proved she can hold her own even in G1 sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which means winning a G1 mile race should be our next goal!
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh! That one's a big race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I bet there will be even stronger racers there! Maybe I can run against Biko again too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Yes, I definitely want to run in that one! Let's do it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That said, going directly from a sprint to a G1 mile race has me a bit worried.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To be safe, I'd like to have her run in a bigger race first. Something around 1,400 meters would be good.
choice_data_list: Let's squeeze in the Swan Stakes first, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That sounds good to me! Swans, huh? They're such nice and big birds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a bit of discussion, our next goal is set. Now that we're ready to get the ball rolling…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Biko? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Sigh… You were really impressive, Bono.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Everyone was so shocked by your running, and their eyes were glittering as they watched you…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yet, I… I…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Nooo! I can't get all sad now! A crestfallen hero is no hero at all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Stand up, Biko Pegasus! Never give in!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: …Biko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Don't tell anyone what you just saw, okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, a bright and powerful racer from the United States lurks nearby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Standing alone next to the nearly empty stands and trembling violently is Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This is so excitin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What a wonderful gal that Hishi Akebono is! She's big and strong—and absolutely thrillin' to watch!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I… I wanna run in a big race with her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All sorts of emotions are running high as the Sprinters S. comes to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next is the Swan S. Now's the time to ramp up our training so Hishi Akebono can really spread her wings and take flight!
